reason: The three thresholds (>=70%, >=300 ms, >30%) are specific numbers presented as decision criteria with no evidence label, while the same chapter explicitly labels its other figures ('These are [ILLUSTRATIVE] pricing and latency figures for Q4 2026', line 115) and marks the adjacent savings as 'the §18.3.3 derived figure'. Within one bullet the derived arithmetic is attributed but the thresholds are unattributed, so they read with the same authority as derived results. Real but minor (P3) consistency defect against the chapter's own labeling practice.
evidence: chapter-18.md line 119: '- **Consolidate** when: workload profile overlap >=70%, latency tolerance >=300 ms, and cost differential >30%. *Verified*: our scenario sits exactly at the threshold...' (no [ILLUSTRATIVE]/[ASSUMPTION] tag); line 115: 'These are [ILLUSTRATIVE] pricing and latency figures for Q4 2026'. grep of lines 117-122 shows no label on the thresholds.
fix_instruction: design/manuscript/chapter-18/chapter-18.md, section 3.5, first bullet (line 119): after 'cost differential >30%.' insert ' These thresholds are [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION] design criteria for the worked example, not universal rules; a deployment should set its own consolidation thresholds from its SLO, cost model and workload mix.'
